Maya: Morning team — quick triage snapshot for this shift (09:00 UTC). Open: 42 tickets (≈ -20% vs 24h). P2s: #4821 (embed mismatch), #4837 (payment webhook retries). P1s: 0. TL;DR: watch webhook errors, macro update live.

Jonah: Taking #4821 — I left a comment asking for the raw payload + model id. Can someone repro with a test key? I'll try to reproduce on staging.

Priya: I can pick up #4837. Attached delivery logs show repeated 502s from third-party gateway. Repro (curl snippet):
```
curl -i -X POST https://hooks.example.com/payment -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"order_id":"test-4837","amount":100}'
```
Response: 502 after ~200ms.

Maya: Thanks @Priya. I pushed a temporary macro to reduce churn for webhook failures: macro id `webhook-retry-ack`. Use `/macro apply webhook-retry-ack` in replies. Excerpt: 
```
"We received your webhook but saw a transient failure. We've queued a retry and will follow up if it fails again. Ref: {{ticket_link}}"
```
Applied to #4837 and #4840. Please adjust wording if it reads too robotic.

support-bot: AUTO: routing rule `payment-webhook` bumped to CRITICAL at 08:57 UTC. Affected customers: 3. Linked tickets: #4837, #4840.

Luis: Quick heads up — embeddings ingestion backfill started at 07:40 UTC. Expect higher cpu on `dedupe-worker` and some backlog in background processing. ETA ~2h, not user-facing but may delay async jobs.

Jonah: Minor PR for macro templating waiting review: github.com/redwood/support/pull/789 — fixes extra blank line when we include ticket links. @Priya can you take a look? It's small.

Priya: :thumbsup: will review in ~30m. Also pushed a tiny edit to `webhook-retry-ack` to include the ticket link and a short apology.

Maya: Blockers: none for triage ops. Today: monitor the webhook retries, validate macro wording on a sample of 10 tickets, close stale low-priority queue, and sync with infra if the backfill impacts latency. Ping me for escalations. :rocket:
